name: catalogcompare-simple
description: Simple rung for the catalogCompare flag (IXT-SUITES batch 6): tier:'simple' feature always present in both modes — enters the catalog, arms compare mode, selects 2 same-category items (both sofas), opens the comparison tray, verifies its columns, then Places one column and confirms the tray closes + placement is armed via activeDefId.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: catalog-visible
steps.failMessage: Catalog drawer did not appear after setCatalogOpen(true)

steps.name: assert-compare-button-present-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Compare items']"); if (!btn) throw new Error('Compare items toggle should be present in Simple mode (catalogCompare is tier:simple)'); })()

steps.name: compare-mode-armed
steps.failMessage: Compare-mode status bar did not appear after arming compare mode

steps.name: select-first-sofa
steps.eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector("[aria-label='Add 3-seat sofa to compare']"); if (!el) throw new Error('3-seat sofa card not found for compare selection'); el.click(); })()

steps.name: select-second-sofa
steps.eval: (() => { const el = document.querySelector("[aria-label='Add 2-seat sofa to compare']"); if (!el) throw new Error('2-seat sofa card not found for compare selection'); el.click(); })()

steps.name: two-selected
steps.failMessage: Compare status bar did not show '2 selected' after picking two same-category items

steps.name: tray-open
steps.failMessage: Compare tray did not open after clicking the enabled Compare button

steps.name: assert-tray-columns
steps.eval: (() => { const cols = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-col')]; if (cols.length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected 2 compare columns, got ' + cols.length); const names = cols.map(c => c.querySelector('.cmp-name')?.textContent?.trim()); if (!names.includes('3-seat sofa') || !names.includes('2-seat sofa')) throw new Error('Compare columns missing expected names: ' + JSON.stringify(names)); const dims = cols.map(c => c.querySelector('.cmp-facts dd')?.textContent?.trim()); if (dims.some(d => !d || !d.includes('m'))) throw new Error('Compare columns missing dims label: ' + JSON.stringify(dims)); })()

steps.name: click-place-first-column
steps.eval: (() => { const col = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-col')].find(c => c.querySelector('.cmp-name')?.textContent?.trim() === '3-seat sofa'); const btn = [...col.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Place'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Place button not found in 3-seat sofa column'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: tray-closed-placement-armed
steps.failMessage: Placement was not armed with sofa-3seat after clicking Place in the compare tray

steps.name: assert-compare-mode-exited
steps.eval: (() => { const overlay = document.querySelector('.modal-overlay'); if (overlay && overlay.textContent?.includes('Compare items')) throw new Error('Compare tray should have closed after Place'); const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.activeDefId !== 'sofa-3seat') throw new Error('Expected activeDefId to be armed as sofa-3seat, got ' + s.activeDefId); })()
